models.buildAdmission: prepare-local-ocr-assets.mjs uses exact size and SHA-256 for cached and downloaded bytes, bounded streaming into a fixed-size buffer, a 60-second fetch timeout and redirect refusal. No user PDFs enter preparation.
models.runtimeAdmission: local-ocr-models.ts reads exact-size local assets into owned storage and verifies SHA-256 before passing provided byte data to loadLanguage. The editor supplies only eng or fra, gzip:false, cacheMethod:none, lstmOnly:true. It uses no credentials, redirects, model URL payload or worker model cache. The 180-second worker deadline and cancellation abort the pending fetch; stop reasons survive asynchronous races.
models.trustLimit: This verifies the allowed model bytes before native parsing, not their internal safety. It does not protect a compromised application bundle, same-origin executable code or substituted native core, and does not establish that arbitrary traineddata is safe. Native Init bindings and traineddata/LSTM parsers still need separate review and fuzzing.

sourceReview.finding: The worker accepts provided model data as well as fetchable language names. The application previously relied only on preparation-time checks and let the worker fetch models. It now provides admitted bytes so changed same-origin assets cannot silently reach initialization through the editor path. Init2/3/4 and wider native ABI are not disabled or cleared by this caller-side check. The pinned fork, not upstream version labels alone, remains the security review target.

nativeResultBoundary.validation: Require arrays/records, bounded collections, string words, finite baseline and ordered finite boxes inside the raster. Normalize only admitted geometry; reject invalid output with content-free errors. Blank entries count toward the budget before filtering.
nativeResultBoundary.limitsOfReview: These checks bound traversal and composition in the parent, not native recognition, result serialization/allocation or worker-to-parent structured clone. Worker termination and memory limits do not constitute whole-native security clearance.

researchApiReduction.scope: Exact optional native PDF-renderer signatures/bodies now abort in the research candidate before allocation/dereference/deletion. Existing 25 raw/ownership, six alternate image-input and four legacy traps remain. The application does not use native PDF rendering. No research core is installed into the app.

verification.scope: Purpose-created synthetic fixtures in isolated Chromium; visible scan bytes render identically before/after invisible text export. No customer documents, public accuracy claim, OCR reconstruction, general corpus equivalence or native WebView2 certification. Unit digest mock covers control flow only; browser integrity tests use actual WebCrypto and model bytes.

remainingGates: Exact native fork/API ownership and traineddata/LSTM/PNM parser review and broader native sanitizer/fuzz coverage.
Final candidate source-to-binary integration, notices/security approval and baseline/SIMD performance/platform policy; candidate is not adopted.
Recognition/alignment benchmarks and browser diversity beyond the synthetic Chromium cases; reference Windows WebView2/offline installer testing on an approved host.
Project licence decision, remaining Windows dependency notice gaps and exact final artifact clearance. No billing or Windows security changes are authorized by this review.
